faq.a: Ma'moun is associated with the Arabic form مَأْمُون, whose core sense is ma'moun; trusted, safe.

faq.q: What is the origin of Ma'moun?
faq.a: Ma'moun is associated with Arabic. Ma'moun is Arabic مَأْمُون (Maʾmūn), the passive participle of أَمِنَ, meaning 'trusted, safe'.
Yes — the underlying form مَأْمُون is Arabic.
Ma'moun can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Ma'moun should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Maʾmūn is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Ma'moun mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Ma'moun is rendered مأمون and carries the sense مأمون، امانت دار.

faq.q: What does Ma'moun mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Ma'moun is rendered مأمون and carries the sense مأمون، امین.
A romanized syllable approximation is ma'-moun. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Ma'moun?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Ma'moun, ma'moun. Script forms are مأمون, مَأْمُون, मामून.

faq.q: Is Ma'moun a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
